entries.content_zh: 生活不是要你站在边线围观，这个世界需要你参与进来。
entries.content_en: Life is not about standing on the sidelines. The world needs you to participate.
entries.context: 2015年乔治华盛顿大学毕业演讲，鼓励毕业生积极参与世界，而非旁观

source.title: 蒂姆·库克2015乔治华盛顿大学毕业演讲
source.event: 乔治华盛顿大学毕业典礼

entries.content_zh: 你不必在做对的事情和过好的生活之间做出选择。这是一个错误的选择，尤其在今天。你的挑战是找到一份能付得起房租、填饱肚子，并让你做正确、正当、好事的工作。
entries.content_en: You don't have to choose between doing good and doing well. It's a false choice, today more than ever. Your challenge is to find work that pays the rent, puts food on the table, and lets you do what is right and good and just.
entries.context: 2015年乔治华盛顿大学毕业演讲，阐述工作与价值观的关系

source.title: 蒂姆·库克2015乔治华盛顿大学毕业演讲
source.event: 乔治华盛顿大学毕业典礼

entries.content_zh: 历史很难被一个人改变——但当有人做到了，他将永远被铭记。这个人可以是你，应该是你，也必将在你们中诞生。
entries.content_en: History rarely yields to one person — but think, and never forget, what happens when it does. That can be you. That should be you. That must be you.
entries.context: 2015年乔治华盛顿大学毕业演讲结尾，激励毕业生改变世界

source.title: 蒂姆·库克2015乔治华盛顿大学毕业演讲
source.event: 乔治华盛顿大学毕业典礼

entries.content_zh: 找到你的价值观，并为之付出一生。你必须找到你的北斗星，那意味着你必须做出选择，有的容易，有的难，有的会让你质疑一切。我遇到了让我质疑一切的人，他用最好的方式结束了我所有的假设，他就是史蒂夫·乔布斯。
entries.content_en: Find your values and dedicate your life to them. You must find your North Star, which means you have to make choices. Some are easy, some are hard, and some will make you question everything. I met someone who made me question everything, who ended all my assumptions in the best possible way. That was Steve Jobs.
entries.context: 2015年乔治华盛顿大学毕业演讲，回忆与乔布斯的相遇

source.title: 蒂姆·库克2015乔治华盛顿大学毕业演讲
source.event: 乔治华盛顿大学毕业典礼

entries.content_zh: 史蒂夫相信苹果能再次变得伟大。他对苹果的愿景是把强大的科技变成好用的工具，用这些工具帮助人们实现梦想，并把世界变得更好。
entries.content_en: Steve believed Apple could be great again. His vision for Apple was to turn powerful technology into easy-to-use tools, tools that help people achieve their dreams and make the world better.
entries.context: 2015年乔治华盛顿大学毕业演讲，描述乔布斯的愿景

source.title: 蒂姆·库克2015乔治华盛顿大学毕业演讲
source.event: 乔治华盛顿大学毕业典礼

entries.content_zh: 当史蒂夫生病时，我根深蒂固地认为他会好起来。我不仅认为他会挺过去，我从心底里确信，即使我离开之后，他仍会长期指引苹果。然后有一天，他打电话让我去他家，告诉我事情不会那样发展。即便如此，我仍然相信他会继续担任董事长。他会从日常事务中退下来，但永远会在那里，作为我们的顾问。但没有理由相信这一点。我本不该这么想。事实摆在眼前。当他真的离开时，我才真正体会到'准备'与'就绪'之间的本质区别。那是我一生中最孤独的时刻。程度之深，难以言表。
entries.content_en: When Steve got sick, I was deeply convinced he would get better. I not only thought he would pull through, I was convinced in my heart that even after I left, he would continue to guide Apple for a long time. Then one day, he called me to his house and told me things wouldn't work out that way. Even then, I still believed he would continue as chairman. He would step back from day-to-day operations, but always be there as our advisor. But there was no reason to believe that. I shouldn't have thought that. The facts were right in front of me. When he truly left, I truly understood the essential difference between 'preparation' and 'readiness.' That was the loneliest moment of my life. The depth of it is beyond words.
entries.context: 2019年斯坦福大学毕业演讲，回忆乔布斯离世时的内心历程

source.title: 蒂姆·库克2019斯坦福大学毕业演讲

entries.content_zh: 当尘埃落定，我只知道，我必须成为最好的自己。我知道，我不能试图成为史蒂夫。那会是一个悲剧，对苹果，对我自己，都是如此。我必须做我自己。这是一个简单的想法，但它花了我很长时间才真正理解。
entries.content_en: When the dust settled, I only knew that I had to be the best version of myself. I knew I couldn't try to be Steve. That would be a tragedy, for Apple and for myself. I had to be myself. It's a simple idea, but it took me a long time to truly understand.
entries.context: 2019年斯坦福大学毕业演讲，阐述接班后的心路历程

source.title: 蒂姆·库克2019斯坦福大学毕业演讲

entries.content_zh: 不要试图模仿那位排除万难的前辈，不要把自己套在不合身的模子里面，那样会耗费太多的精力，而这些精力本应用于创造和建造那些只属于你自己的事物。
entries.content_en: Don't try to imitate the predecessor who overcame all obstacles. Don't force yourself into a mold that doesn't fit. That consumes too much energy that should be used to create and build things that are uniquely yours.
entries.context: 2019年斯坦福大学毕业演讲，鼓励毕业生找到自己的道路

source.title: 蒂姆·库克2019斯坦福大学毕业演讲

entries.content_zh: 你们不必迷茫不安。在意料之外发现希望，在挑战之中找到勇气，在荒僻之路上找到未来的方向。面对未来，你永远不可能准备好，但事实是，你也无需准备好。
entries.content_en: You don't have to be lost and anxious. Find hope in the unexpected, courage in challenges, and direction for the future on untrodden paths. You can never be fully prepared for the future, but the truth is, you don't need to be.
entries.context: 2019年斯坦福大学毕业演讲，安慰毕业生面对未来的不确定性

source.title: 蒂姆·库克2019斯坦福大学毕业演讲

entries.content_zh: 科技不会改变我们的本质，只会放大我们的本性——无论是善是恶。我们在科技、政治等任何领域的问题，本质都是人的问题。
entries.content_en: Technology won't change our essence, it only amplifies our nature — for better or worse. The problems we face in technology, politics, or any field are fundamentally human problems.
entries.context: 2019年斯坦福大学毕业演讲，论述科技与人性的关系

source.title: 蒂姆·库克2019斯坦福大学毕业演讲

entries.content_zh: 如果你想获得荣誉，首先就要学会承担责任。这听起来很简单，但它暴露了我们这个时代最大的虚伪。我们欣然拥抱科技带来的便利，却在问题出现时逃避责任。
entries.content_en: If you want to enjoy honor, first learn to bear responsibility. It sounds simple, but it exposes the greatest hypocrisy of our time. We readily embrace the convenience brought by technology, yet evade responsibility when problems arise.
entries.context: 2019年斯坦福大学毕业演讲，强调荣誉与责任的关系

source.title: 蒂姆·库克2019斯坦福大学毕业演讲

entries.content_zh: 真正的创新者，或许不应该只是那些创造新奇事物的人，更应该是那些愿意为自己所砌的每一块砖所投下的阴影负责的人。
entries.content_en: True innovators may not just be those who create novel things, but rather those willing to take responsibility for the shadow cast by every brick they lay.
entries.context: 2019年斯坦福大学毕业演讲，重新定义创新者的责任

source.title: 蒂姆·库克2019斯坦福大学毕业演讲

entries.content_zh: 如果没有人能给予你们想要的生活，那就自己去建立。成就是带不走的，你得把它留给后人。
entries.content_en: If no one can give you the life you want, build it yourself. Achievement cannot be taken with you; you must leave it for those who come after.
entries.context: 2019年斯坦福大学毕业演讲，鼓励毕业生主动创造

source.title: 蒂姆·库克2019斯坦福大学毕业演讲

entries.content_zh: 当你离开这里，走向世界，请记住：做正确的事，即使它很难，即使它不受欢迎，即使它代价高昂。因为最终，重要的不是你得到了什么，而是你给予了什么；不是你取得了什么成就，而是你改变了什么。
entries.content_en: When you leave here and go out into the world, remember: Do the right thing, even when it's hard, even when it's unpopular, even when it's costly. Because in the end, what matters is not what you got, but what you gave; not what you achieved, but what you changed.
entries.context: 2019年斯坦福大学毕业演讲结尾，总结核心价值观

source.title: 蒂姆·库克2019斯坦福大学毕业演讲

entries.content_zh: 没人能成为第二个乔布斯，我只做我自己。
entries.content_en: No one can be the second Steve Jobs. I can only be myself.
entries.context: 多次采访中表达的接班态度

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 每个CEO都需要有顶住非议的力量。
entries.content_en: Every CEO needs the strength to withstand criticism.
entries.context: 关于CEO领导力的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 人太敏感、耳根子太软，是当不了CEO的。社交媒体上有太多的噪音，你要坚持自己的决定。
entries.content_en: If you're too sensitive and easily influenced, you can't be a CEO. There's too much noise on social media; you have to stick to your decisions.
entries.context: 关于CEO决策力的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 宁做最好，不做最早。
entries.content_en: Better to be the best than to be the first.
entries.context: 关于苹果产品策略的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 最重要的决定就是不做什么。
entries.content_en: The most important decision is what not to do.
entries.context: 关于产品决策的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 我们的目的是，创造最好的产品来丰富人们的生活。
entries.content_en: Our purpose is to create the best products to enrich people's lives.
entries.context: 关于苹果使命的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 有些人认为创新就是改变，我们从来不这么看，我认为，让事情变得更好，就是创新。
entries.content_en: Some people think innovation is change. We never see it that way. I believe making things better is innovation.
entries.context: 关于创新理念的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 将强大的技术转变成容易使用的工具，这些工具可以帮助人们实现自己的梦想，更好的改变世界。
entries.content_en: Turn powerful technology into easy-to-use tools that help people achieve their dreams and change the world for the better.
entries.context: 关于苹果产品哲学的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 我们所有的想法都是最好的，苹果公司只选择其中一种，并努力把它做到极致，其他的都会果断放弃。
entries.content_en: All our ideas are the best, but Apple only chooses one and strives to make it极致, decisively abandoning the rest.
entries.context: 关于苹果决策哲学的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 我们拒绝以技术为借口，剥夺用户的隐私权。因此苹果选择了一条不同的道路：尽可能不去收集用户数据。我们非常尊重用户的权利和思想，因此我们知道这一切都属于用户。
entries.content_en: We refuse to use technology as an excuse to deprive users of their privacy rights. Therefore, Apple has chosen a different path: collect as little user data as possible. We deeply respect users' rights and thoughts, so we know all of this belongs to the users.
entries.context: 关于隐私保护的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 有一种不遵守多数原则的东西，那就是人的良心。
entries.content_en: There is something that doesn't obey the majority rule, and that is human conscience.
entries.context: 关于价值观的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 生命短暂，不要浪费时间活出别人的样子。
entries.content_en: Life is short. Don't waste time living someone else's life.
entries.context: 关于人生态度的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 不要把自己的时间浪费在别人身上，不要费劲力气去模仿前人，你所模仿的这一切，也许不是最适合你的，这会导致大量的精神内耗。你的精力本就应该用于去创造，去构建自己的人生。
entries.content_en: Don't waste your time on others, don't exert effort imitating predecessors. What you imitate may not be the best fit for you, leading to significant mental exhaustion. Your energy should be used to create and build your own life.
entries.context: 关于个人成长的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 你的雄心要有与之匹配的谦卑，是一种带有目标的谦卑。这并不意味着你要变得循规蹈矩，恰恰相反，谦卑是为了做更伟大的事情服务。
entries.content_en: Your ambition should be matched with humility — a humility with purpose. This doesn't mean becoming conventional. On the contrary, humility serves the purpose of doing greater things.
entries.context: 关于领导力与谦卑的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 有时候会遇到困境，但它给予了给自己的信心，让我走自己的路，超越逆境，抛开偏见。它也给予了我犀牛一样的皮肤，当你成为苹果CEO的时候，迟早会派上用场。
entries.content_en: Sometimes you encounter difficulties, but they give you confidence to walk your own path, transcend adversity, and leave prejudice behind. They also give you skin as thick as a rhinoceros — which comes in handy when you become CEO of Apple.
entries.context: 关于个人成长与抗压的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 我有幸能够从一个人身上学习到这一点，这个人对不同凡想的理念深信不疑。他知道改变世界要从追求一个愿景开始，而不是按部就班，他就是我的良师益友乔布斯。乔布斯的愿景就是，奇思妙想源于对不安于现状的拒绝。
entries.content_en: I was fortunate to learn this from someone who deeply believed in the concept of thinking different. He knew that changing the world starts with pursuing a vision, not following routines. He was my mentor and friend, Steve Jobs. Jobs' vision was that wild ideas come from refusing to be satisfied with the status quo.
entries.context: 关于乔布斯影响的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 金钱永远不是早起的理由，把事情做好，自然就有收获了。
entries.content_en: Money is never the reason to get up early. Do things well, and rewards will naturally follow.
entries.context: 关于工作态度的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 在技术圈有这样一种现象，几乎是一种病态，那就是对成功的定义。你能拿到多少点击量，你拥有多少活跃用户，你销售了多少台设备。每一个技术圈的人都想要大数据，但乔布斯从不被这些所影响，他只专注于做到最好。
entries.content_en: There's a phenomenon in the tech industry, almost a pathology, about defining success. How many clicks you get, how many active users you have, how many devices you sell. Everyone in tech wants big data, but Jobs was never influenced by these. He only focused on being the best.
entries.context: 关于成功定义的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 你要像从事奶制品行业一样管理公司，如果奶制品过了保质期，问题就来了。
entries.content_en: You should manage a company like you're in the dairy business. If the milk passes its expiration date, you have a problem.
entries.context: 关于公司管理的经典语录，强调时效性

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 我们追求的，不是中国市场份额第一，而是最好的产品。
entries.content_en: What we pursue is not being number one in market share in China, but the best products.
entries.context: 关于中国市场策略的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 中国市场确实特殊，时间窗口只有5-10年。
entries.content_en: The Chinese market is indeed special, with a time window of only 5-10 years.
entries.context: 关于中国市场机遇的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 环保事业不仅仅是环保，未来也会赚钱。
entries.content_en: Environmental efforts are not just about the environment; they will also be profitable in the future.
entries.context: 关于环保与商业的经典语录

source.title: 我不做第二个乔布斯，回顾苹果新掌门库克的25句经典语录

entries.content_zh: 过去15年来，我几乎每天早上都以同样的方式开始：打开邮箱，阅读前一天来自全球各地Apple用户的来信。你们与我分享生活的点滴，告诉我Apple如何融入你们的故事——比如母亲的Apple Watch救了她一命的瞬间；在无人相信你能登顶的山峰上拍下的完美自拍。你们感谢Mac改变了工作的可能性，有时也会告诉我，某些你在意的功能没有达到预期。在每一封邮件里，我都能感受到人类共通的心跳。我感受到一种越来越重的责任，要更努力、走更远。但最重要的是，我心中有一种难以言喻的感激——我竟然能成为邮件另一端的人，领导一家以难以描述的方式激发想象、丰富生命的公司。这是何等的荣幸。
entries.content_en: For the past 15 years, I've started nearly every morning the same way: I open my email and read messages from Apple users around the world that arrived the day before. You share little pieces of your life with me, telling me how Apple has woven itself into your story — the moment your mom's Apple Watch saved her life; the perfect selfie at the top of a mountain no one thought you could climb. You thank me for how Mac has transformed what's possible in your work, and sometimes you let me know when something you care about isn't working as you expect. In every one of those emails, I feel the beating heart of our shared humanity. I feel a sense of deepening obligation to work harder and push further. But most of all, I feel a gratitude that I cannot put into words — that I somehow got to be the person on the other end of those emails, the leader of a company that ignites imaginations and enriches lives in such profound ways it defies description. What an honor and a privilege it has been.

And most of all, thank you for trusting me to lead this company that exists for you.

entries.content_en: It's been the honor of a lifetime to work here, and I will continue until the voice in my head says 'it's time,' and then I will focus on the next chapter. But it's hard to imagine life without Apple, because since 1998, my life has been intimately connected with this company. It's been the vast majority of my adult life. So I love it.

entries.content_zh: 我不会说有一个'啊哈时刻'。它就像波浪一样，或者像滚雷一样建立起来了。早在2017年，我们就在产品中内置了一个神经引擎。当时，人工智能和机器学习的巨大潜力已经显而易见......很明显，我们必须将大量人员分流到这一领域，这将是我们产品的一个新时代。
entries.content_en: I wouldn't say there was an 'aha moment.' It built up like waves, or like rolling thunder. As early as 2017, we built a neural engine into our products. At that time, the enormous potential of AI and machine learning was already obvious... It was clear we had to divert significant personnel to this area. This would be a new era for our products.
